title: Ordinary coefficient recursion before completion
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite-dimensional coefficient extension E/Q_l, the actual strict-system operations o and normalized ambient models a [def-sf-integral-realization-assembly-data]. For any scheme B, input family X:I→Over B, ordinary integral input family K, and finite typed expression e ending on W [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], construct a map R_W(e_ringed K)→e_system(R K). Use identity on variables, the prescribed reductionPull on pullback, its geometric adjunction mate on proper image, inverseOrZero of the prescribed open reduction mate on open extension, and the ordinary tensor identification followed by reductionTensor on tensor. Each operation applies to the already constructed child maps; compact support is the same open-then-proper composite. These maps use no realization comparison, no completion inverse and no existence choice.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.
